book.name: 1 KORINTUS
book.title: Nyovara Wao Manasyin Paulus Po Ratoe Anugano Amisye Mai No Korintus 1 KORINTUS

content: Kristus apa kakai no inyo kapite raura
Risya arakove weap! Arono ride wasai syo Amisye apa ayao ravovo wasai no wusyinoe, syayao papirabe rave jewen muno syo mine so ama ana ratantona ntiti raura ramu.

Weye syo raija matuve no inanuga mamo syo anakotaro mine so inta raura ramu arono rino wasarijat. Yara Yesus Kristus webo pi no inakari rai, ti syo raura terave mamo syare Opamo kakai no inyo kapite rai to.
Arono rino wasarijat, rino sya mayondi rautan muno rijaniv ti itutar dave.
Muno sya ayao syo raura wasai mamo syayao papirabe mine so ama ana ratantona ntiti raije ramu. Yara arono syo raura wasai, Amisye apa Anawayo Vambunine mo ama vambunine raroron.
Wirati wapa anave mamo vemo nsawa vatane awa wo ratantona ntiti rai nora, yara Amisy apa vambunin obo rai.
Amisye apa ana po ratantona ntiti

Maisyare wemai damu arono syananyaube no vatano wo Amisye aene matu to awa yasyine rai, weamo syo ana ratantona ntiti inta ranyao mai. Weramu sya ananyao syo raugaje mamo nsasye irati mine so ama ana ratantona ntiti rai, muno nsasyeo akarijo mine so awa ana wo ratantona ntiti rai tavon, weye akarijo nanawiso awa vambunine indati rakanive.

Reamo ravovo wasai mamo Amisye apa ana po ratantona ntiti mije. No taiso: arono nuge so ranari rainy, Amisye po rapatimu indamu Po kovo ntiti raunande wansai, weramu Apa ana po rapatimu so rangkokaibeve, weti vatano mine so wantatukambe rai vintabo.
Muno akarijo mine so wo raen tavone ramu. Weramu ranivara wo raen datire ma, indati wo Amisy Yesus auseo sawa inyo kapite raije ramu, Wepi apa kove ntiti rave.
Maisyare Ayao Amisye mo ratoe mare:

content.text: vatano umuinyo Ai mansai omamo ntiti rave.
Anakotaro namije mamo vatane mansami mo raen dainy,
muno ntipu no manuga rai rainy.”

content: Weramu Amisye apa Anawayo Vambunine mo anakotaro namije rarorono wansai to. Weye Anawayo Vambunine nanto anakotare rai tenambe muno mo ayao ngkokaibe no Amisye anuga rai raen tavon.

Vatane wamamo inta taune pirati po taune apa ana po ratantona raen, yara indati vatano kaijinta wo apa raene jewen. Maisyare omaisy, vatane wamamo inta po Amisye apa ana no aije raene jewen, yara Anawayo Amisy obo mirati mo raen.
Ana ratantona mine somamo Amisye po raunande wansai jewen, yara Po taune apa Anawayo Vambunine raunande wansai. Apa Anawayo Vambunine raunande indamu wananta Amisye apa kovo po raugaje wansai rai.

Weti arono reamo vatane mansanyao, reama ayao mamo nori rati vatano mine so awa ana wo ratantona ntiti rai ramu. Yara Anawayo Vambunine ama ayao mo raugaje omirati reamo veano vatane mansanyao, nanawirati Anawayo Vambunine no mansanuga rai.

Weramu vatano nanawirati Amisye apa Anawayo Vambunine no maije jewen onawamo umayar wavakananto Ama ananyao rai ramu, weye ware ama ine meweno rai. Unanta Ama ananyao rai kakai, weye Anawayo Amisye obo mirati mo vatane mauga ti unanta rai.

Yara vatano Anawayo Amisye no wansai wamamo wananta anakotar tenambe rai rui ngkov, rui ngkakai. Wananta anakotare so rai weye Kristus apa ana po ratantona no wansai. Weramu vatano mine so unanta irati vatano wamanave wama ana no wansai raije ramu. Ayao Amisye mo ratoe mare:

content.text: “Vatane unanta Amisye apa ana po ratantona rai jewen bintabo,
weti vatane wo Amisye anyao kakai.”

content: Weramu wamamo Yesus Kristus apa ana po ratantona no wansai.
